questions: What can still be wrong even if the checks pass?
What integration or rollout risk remains?
What would a zero-context reader understand incorrectly or fail to understand?
Did the artifact optimize the user's real success function or only a structural proxy?
Is there meta, deploy, implementation, or delivery sludge that should not be in the public artifact?
Did scope_guard_passed prove every changed path is intentional?
Did the unit prove that the real input or dataset still exists in sufficient quantity and semantics after filtering?
